SHA-256 hashing APIs, state layout, and batch hashing helpers.

# Purpose
This header defines the public API for SHA-256 hashing in `fd_sha256`. It declares the `fd_sha256_t` state object, the memory layout constants, and the functions used to create, join, leave, initialize, update, and finish a hash calculation. It also provides helper functions for one-shot hashing and repeated hashing of a 32-byte value. The file includes a batch hashing interface with three implementation choices: a reference path, an AVX path, and an AVX-512 path, selected by compile-time feature tests.
